puzzle.hint: Allah's miraculous protection of Prophet Ibrahim when his people threw him into a blazing fire — a story of absolute trust (tawakkul) and divine rescue.
puzzle.arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
puzzle.verseEn: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
